description: This file defines the class QueryFilterCriteriaFactory, which provides methods for creating and manipulating query filter criteria within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes logic for parsing filter strings, restricting criteria by namespace, and generating criteria based on RQL expressions.

classes.name: QueryFilterCriteriaFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing query filter criteria, including parsing RQL filter strings and restricting criteria by namespace.

methods.name: modelBased
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the model-based query filter criteria factory.

methods.name: filterCriteriaRestrictedByNamespaces
methods.description: Creates a filter criterion based on a filter string and restricts it to specified namespaces.

methods.name: filterCriteria
methods.description: Generates a criteria object from a filter string, or returns a default criteria if the filter is null.

methods.name: toCriteriaFactory
methods.description: Returns the underlying CriteriaFactory used by this factory.
